description: How have German house prices moved? Paid ($0.03 USDC): Destatis quarterly house price index (base 2025=100) for Germany, all / new / existing dwellings, latest, 4-quarter and 12-quarter change (dl-de/by-2-0; no endorsement by Destatis). Information, not financial advice. This server holds no wallet and never pays: it returns the HTTP 402 payment requirements (x402 on Base, MPP on Tempo) and the URL https://rent-check-production.up.railway.app/v1/de-house-prices. Pay with your own x402/MPP client and retry that URL.
name: paid_de_house_prices
